title: Normalize Flow Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item*/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled FlowPlayLabels struct+consts+resolver and flow_action_labels/app_labels struct-literal, adopt SDK Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/paired_apps/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local test scaffolding, verify resource_kind() already present, verify C1 naming (FlowPlayApp already matches PascalCase("flow-play")+"App"), fix regions (wrap tests mod in //#region 🧪Tests / //#endregion 🧪Tests; confirm canonical region order), confirm single-app crate stays flat (no app_<name> mod wrapping needed).
